name: 弓手
status: pending: proposed beginner card for the one-lane tutorial stages (1-2 to 1-7). Save the picture as archer.png here, then run tools/prepare_assets.gd and --import.
must_differ_from: hunter.png (older man, long red liripipe hood, longbow, two quivers) and militia-red.png (spear and round shield). The archer shares the militia's kettle helmet and cream coif so it reads as a town levy, but carries a short bow and only one quiver.
prompt: Production 2D sprite for a medieval illuminated manuscript strategy game. Genuine transparent background. Single isolated subject fully visible, generous padding. Bold clean dark brown ink contours, large flat matte gouache shapes, minimal hatching, charming sturdy proportions readable at 70 pixels. Muted vermilion, indigo, ochre, ivory palette. No text, border, scenery, base, shadow, glow, vignette or photorealism. Character faces RIGHT in three-quarter side view, full body from helmet to boots. A young village levy archer, clean-shaven and earnest: plain round steel kettle helmet over a cream linen coif, knee-length RED padded tunic with a brown leather belt, slate-blue hose, short brown boots. He stands in a steady stance drawing a SHORT plain wooden self bow (no taller than his chest) with an arrow nocked and aimed straight to the right. One small brown leather quiver with a few white-fletched arrows hangs at his right hip. No hood, no cape, no sword, no shield, no second quiver. Only the tunic is red (for team recoloring); keep the helmet, skin, wood, leather and hose free of red.
negative: hood, liripipe, long bow taller than the figure, beard, old man, cape, shield, spear, background, ground, shadow, frame, text, watermark, checkerboard
usage: single shared sprite for both teams; no separate blue variant
